recreation_notes.text:
****************************************************************

        Grand Tour (Bally 1964)
            v 2.0
         Script by Scottacus
             July 2021

Basic DOF config
  71 - 80 BackGlass Slides
  90  BackGlass On Image
  101 Left Flipper, 102 Right Flipper
  103 Left Sling, 104 Right Sling
  105 Bumper1, 106 Bumper2, 107 Bumper3
  124 Drain, 125 Ball Release
  130 - 136 Wire Rollovers
  141 Chime1-10s, 142 Chime2-100s, 143 Chime3-1000s
  151 - 152 Butterfly Rollovers
  160 - 161 Rollover Buttons
  170 - 173 Mushrooms
  199 credit light
  128 Knocker & Strobe
  165 Ball In Shooter Lane

  Code Flow
                 EndGame
                  ^
  Start Game -> New Game -> Check Continue -> Release Ball -> Drain -> Next Ball
                  ^                   |
                EndGame = True <-----------------------------

Note Score Motor Location for sound routines is at shootAgain Light
Ball Control Subroutine developed by: rothbauerw
  Press "c" during play to activate, the arrow keys control the ball, "." will levitate the ball, press "c" to drop it.
**********************************************************************************************************************
Physical elements are on layer 2 w/ leaf switch rubbers separated for individual hit events.
